question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Confidence."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Confidence" **is the best fit in this context.
 
• **"Confidence"** means trust or strong belief in somebody/something. ((किसी पर) भरोसा या पक्‍का विश्‍वास)
 
 
• **Example**: *The public is losing **confidence**__ in the present government.*
 
 
 
• We are discussing the experience of public speaking, and confidence is something that public speakers certainly need to gain.
 
• Therefore **"confidence" **is the most suited word to go into blank no. 4.
 
• It aligns with the context of the struggle that public speakers face and the goal they might tend to achieve.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is Option 4.
 
• **Correct passage**:

The ability to think clearly and calmly while addressing a __**confidence**__ is neither inborn nor difficult to develop. The presence of an audience should act as a stimulus and not as a ______ (2) ______ to thought. Audience fright can be overcome through training and practice. Even great speakers ______ (3) ______ stage fright and self-consciousness. Every speaker gets worked up and experiences strain, shock, and excitement before he or she begins to talk. But every speaker who is struggling to gain ______ (4) ______ should remember that all meritorious public

speaking is accompanied by a little ______ (5) ______.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Merit: **the quality of being good. (गुण, ख़ूबी, अच्‍छाई)
 
• **Profit: **the money that you make when you sell something for more than it cost you. (लागत से अधिक दाम पर बेचने से प्राप्‍त धन; नफ़ा, लाभ, फ़ायदा)
 
• **Money: **the means of paying for something or buying something [coins or notes]. (धन, पैसा (सिक्‍के या नोट))
